articles.title: Aligarh Road Rage Turns Violent: Woman Allegedly Beaten Until She Collapses, Video Goes Viral
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An argument between a motorcyclist couple and a car driver in Aligarh's Mangal Dham Colony escalated into violence when the driver allegedly assaulted the woman, leaving her unconscious before fleeing. A viral video captured the incident, prompting Aligarh Police to register a case.

body.html:
A woman was allegedly assaulted following a verbal altercation in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, with a video of the incident circulating widely on social media.

The incident reportedly took place in Mangal Dham Colony, under the limits of Delhi Gate Police Station. According to reports, an argument broke out between a couple travelling on a motorcycle and a young man who was driving a car.

The dispute allegedly escalated when the car driver assaulted the woman on the road. In the viral video, the man is seen allegedly beating the woman, following which she appears to lose consciousness and collapse on the ground.

The accused allegedly fled the spot in his car after the incident.

The video circulating on social media has not been independently verified.

Aligarh Police said a case has been registered in connection with the incident and an investigation is underway. The concerned parties have been directed to proceed with further legal action based on the evidence.

articles.title: 'Go Complain to Anyone': Government Doctor Refuses to Treat Woman, Heated Argument Caught on Camera
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Andhra Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A government doctor at a public hospital in Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, faces widespread backlash after a viral video captured him allegedly refusing to treat a collapsed woman. Despite family pleas following her fall, the doctor engaged in a heated argument, dismissed the case, and dared the

body.html:
A government doctor at a public hospital in Chinna Gottigallu of Andhra Pradesh's Tirupati district has come under fire after allegedly refusing to treat a woman and engaging in a heated argument with her family members. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

According to the family, they brought the woman to the government hospital after she reportedly fainted following a fall from a staircase and requested immediate medical attention.

The viral video allegedly shows the doctor sitting with his legs crossed and ignoring the patient, prompting a female relative to question his behaviour. During the argument, the doctor is heard claiming that it was not an emergency case.

The patient's family insisted that the woman had collapsed after falling down the stairs and required treatment. However, the doctor allegedly refused to attend to her, telling the family that he would not provide treatment and asking them to "complain to anyone" they wished.

The video has triggered outrage on social media, with many users questioning the conduct of the government doctor and demanding action. Authorities are yet to issue an official statement on the incident.

articles.title: 9-Minute CCTV Gap Exposes Bridge Murder: Boyfriend Arrested After Woman Thrown to Death in Nagpur
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kanhan Police solved the murder of 29-year-old Ashwini Dey, who was pushed off the old Kanhan river bridge in Nagpur district. Her boyfriend, Ashish Manpiya (31), was arrested after a crucial nine-minute gap between CCTV clips and a railway trackman's testimony helped police crack the case.

body.html:
A crucial nine-minute gap between two CCTV recordings and the testimony of a railway trackman helped Kanhan Police solve the alleged murder of a 29-year-old woman who was pushed off the old Kanhan river bridge in Maharashtra's Nagpur district.

Police have arrested Ashish alias Monu Kishor Manpiya (31), a resident of Bhilgaon, for the murder of his girlfriend, Ashwini alias Aashi Dey (29). A local court has remanded him to police custody until August 11.

According to investigators, the murder took place between 2.08 am and 2.17 am on Monday. CCTV footage allegedly showed Ashish riding towards the old Kanhan bridge with Aashi at around 2.08 am, while another camera captured him returning alone at approximately 2.17 am, establishing a critical nine-minute timeline.

Police said Ashish had arrived at Aashi's residence late on Sunday night. After she returned home, she informed her mother that she was dropping him home and would return shortly. Instead, the two rode around several parts of Nagpur, including Tajbagh, Kamptee Road and Khaparkheda, before reaching the old Kanhan bridge around 2 am.

Investigators suspect the couple had consumed the synthetic drug MD before the incident. Police said both had criminal backgrounds, with multiple cases registered against Ashish and two cases against Aashi, who was also known to police as an informer.

According to the investigation, the couple stopped at a secluded stretch of the bridge, where an argument allegedly broke out. Police claimed Aashi was pressuring Ashish to marry her and had also demanded a Friendship Day gift. During interrogation, the accused allegedly admitted that the repeated demands led to a heated confrontation.

Police alleged that Ashish then pushed Aashi off the bridge onto a rocky section of the riverbed, where the shallow water and large rocks left little chance of survival.

A railway trackman on night patrol became a key witness in the case. Police said he clicked a selfie at around 2.01 am and shared it in an official railway WhatsApp group. Minutes later, he heard a loud sound from the bridge, shone his torch towards the river, and found Aashi lying motionless below. He immediately alerted the police.

Investigators said the trackman's statement, combined with CCTV footage and technical evidence, played a crucial role in cracking the case within 24 hours.

After the incident, the accused allegedly rode to the Panchmukhi Hanuman Temple in Khaparkheda before returning home in an apparent attempt to avoid suspicion. Acting on specific intelligence, police later traced and arrested him from Automobile Chowk in Nagpur.

A case has been registered under Section 103(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) based on the railway trackman's complaint. Police are continuing the investigation and are also probing the accused's alleged criminal network, suspected drug-peddling links, and any wider underworld connections.

articles.title: Caught on Camera: Man Held After Allegedly Assaulting Woman Inside Ghaziabad Mall
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man was taken into custody after a viral video showed him assaulting a woman inside Jaipuria Mall in Ghaziabad's Indirapuram. Police confirmed the two knew each other and fought over a dispute. An FIR has been registered at Indirapuram Police Station, and further legal action is underway.

body.html:
A man has been taken into custody after a video allegedly showing him assaulting a woman inside Jaipuria Mall in Ghaziabad's Indirapuram went viral on social media, prompting swift police action.

According to police, an inquiry was launched after the footage surfaced online. The investigation confirmed that the incident took place inside Jaipuria Mall in the Indirapuram area.

Police said the man and the woman were known to each other before the incident. A dispute reportedly broke out between them, following which the man allegedly assaulted the woman.

Based on the preliminary investigation, an FIR has been registered at Indirapuram Police Station under the relevant provisions of law. The accused has been taken into custody and is being questioned.

Police said further legal action is underway, and the investigation into the incident is continuing.

articles.title: Teacher Caught Sleeping in Classroom as Students Watch Mobile Phone; Viral Video
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A viral video allegedly showing a government school teacher in UP's Kannauj district sleeping on a bench while unattended students gathered around a mobile phone has sparked public outrage and renewed calls for teacher accountability and better classroom supervision.

body.html:
A government school teacher in Uttar Pradesh's Kannauj district has come under scrutiny after a viral video allegedly showed the teacher sleeping during school hours while students gathered around a mobile phone inside the classroom.

The video, which has been widely shared on social media, shows the teacher lying on a bench, apparently asleep, as students remain unattended and watch content on a mobile device. The footage has sparked outrage among parents and social media users, raising concerns over classroom supervision and the quality of education.

The clip was shared on X by a user identified as 'Zingabad', who also tagged the Kannauj Police while posting the video. The incident has triggered widespread criticism, with many questioning teacher accountability and the functioning of the school.

It is not yet clear when the video was recorded, and no official statement has been issued by the school administration or district education authorities. The authenticity of the viral video has also not been independently verified.

The incident has renewed concerns over student supervision in schools and the growing use of mobile phones during class hours. Parents and local residents have called for a thorough inquiry and appropriate action if the allegations are found to be true.

articles.title: Beer Party on Moving Thar? Viral Video Shows Youths Creating Ruckus Outside Liquor Shop in Rudrapur
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Nainital)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A viral video from Rudrapur shows a group of youths drinking beer on top of a Thar SUV and creating a ruckus near a liquor shop on the Delhi-Nainital Highway. The group fled before police arrived, but authorities have taken cognisance of the footage and are working to identify

body.html:
A video circulating on social media allegedly shows a group of youths drinking beer while sitting on top of a Thar SUV and creating a ruckus outside a liquor shop near the Roadways Bus Stand on the Delhi–Nainital Highway in Rudrapur.

According to local residents, the youths were confronted over their behaviour, after which bystanders began recording the incident. Before police could reach the spot, the group allegedly fled in the SUV.

Police have taken cognisance of the viral video and said efforts are underway to identify those involved. Officials added that appropriate legal action will be taken once the individuals are identified.

articles.title: Auto Driver Allegedly Assaults Car Driver After Minor Collision Sparks Road Rage in Bengaluru
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Karnataka)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A road rage incident in Bengaluru's Banaswadi area saw an auto-rickshaw driver physically assault a car driver following a minor collision. A video of the altercation has gone viral on social media, sparking widespread concern over increasing traffic-related violence in the city.

body.html:
A road rage incident was reported in Bengaluru after an auto-rickshaw driver allegedly assaulted a car driver following a minor collision between their vehicles.

The incident took place on August 1 near Ayyappa Swamy Temple under the jurisdiction of the Banaswadi Police Station. According to police, the dispute began after the auto-rickshaw and the car reportedly brushed against each other. The argument quickly escalated, with the auto driver allegedly physically assaulting the car driver in the middle of the road.

A video of the incident has since surfaced on social media, drawing widespread attention.

The incident has once again highlighted the growing number of road rage cases in Bengaluru, where minor traffic-related disputes are increasingly turning into violent confrontations.

articles.title: 50-Foot High-Mast Light Collapses at Visakhapatnam Railway Stadium Amid Strong Winds
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 50-foot high-mast floodlight at Visakhapatnam's Railway Stadium collapsed onto the spectators' gallery due to strong winds during Independence Day preparations. Fortunately, no injuries were reported as the area was deserted.

body.html:
A 50-foot high-mast floodlight collapsed due to strong winds at the Railway Stadium in Visakhapatnam, narrowly avoiding a major tragedy after crashing towards the spectators' gallery.

The incident occurred while preparations were underway at the stadium for Independence Day celebrations. Fortunately, no workers or visitors were present in the area where the mast fell, and no injuries were reported.

The Railway Stadium regularly hosts first-class cricket matches, football matches, and is also frequented by hundreds of people every morning and evening for walking and jogging. However, due to rain and gusty winds at the time of the incident, the ground was largely deserted.

The collapse has raised concerns over the quality of the structure and its maintenance, as the high-mast light reportedly gave way during a brief spell of strong winds.

Railway officials have launched an inquiry to determine the exact cause of the collapse and said appropriate action will be taken based on the findings.

Meanwhile, the Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority (APSDMA) has issued weather warnings for several districts, forecasting moderate rainfall, lightning, and strong winds over the next few hours.

An Orange Alert has been issued for Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, Alluri Sitarama Raju, and Anakapalli districts. Authorities have also warned of possible lightning in and around Araku, Chintapalli, Narsipatnam, Elamanchili, Anakapalli, and Visakhapatnam.

The public has been advised to avoid standing under trees, stay away from open areas during thunderstorms, and follow official safety advisories.

articles.title: Kanwariya Clash Turns Violent in Meerut; Constable Injured While Trying to Stop Fight
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dispute between two groups of Kanwariyas in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, escalated into a violent clash, injuring a police constable who attempted to intervene. The injured were hospitalized, and police have launched an investigation while seizing vehicles found at the scene.

body.html:
A minor dispute between two groups of Kanwariyas during the Kanwar Yatra in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, escalated into violence late Monday night, leaving a police constable injured after he allegedly came under attack while trying to defuse the situation.

The incident took place around 3 am in front of Dharam Hotel in the Daurala area.

According to police, Vikas Mishra, a resident of Devki Colony in Delhi, was returning from Haridwar with his companions carrying Kanwar when the motorcycle of Sonu Yadav and Guddu, residents of Haibatpur in Gautam Buddh Nagar district, allegedly collided with the group.

The collision triggered a heated argument, which quickly escalated into a physical fight.

Hearing the commotion, UP Police constable Dinesh and other personnel deployed nearby rushed to the spot. While attempting to pacify both groups, the constable was allegedly attacked with sticks during the scuffle, sustaining a head injury.

Additional police personnel arrived shortly afterward and brought the situation under control.

Police shifted the injured Kanwariyas, identified as Sonu, Ayush, Sagar, Vikas, and Guddu, along with the injured constable, to the Daurala Community Health Centre (CHC) for treatment.

During the preliminary investigation, police found that the Kanwariyas travelling on the motorcycle were on their way to Haridwar to collect holy water. They had reportedly left a bag at a highway dhaba and were returning via the Kanwariya route to retrieve it when their motorcycle collided with the oncoming group.

Inspector Suman Singh of Daurala Police Station later reached the spot, counselled both groups, and warned them against repeating such behaviour.

Police also seized two scooters and one motorcycle found abandoned at the scene and have launched an investigation into the incident.

articles.title: ‘Road Accident’ or Murder? Andhra Man Found Dead on Highway as CCTV Raises Suspicion
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Andhra Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Subrahmanyam, a 47-year-old man from Andhra Pradesh's Pileru, was initially believed to have died in a hit-and-run after his body was found on the Tirupati highway. However, CCTV footage and bloodstains at his home led police to suspect he was murdered and staged as an accident.

body.html:
A suspicious death in Pileru town of Andhra Pradesh has taken a dramatic turn after CCTV footage and other evidence reportedly led police to suspect that a 47-year-old man was murdered at his home and his body later dumped on the Tirupati highway.

The deceased has been identified as Subrahmanyam, a resident of Dish Colony in Pileru.

His body was found with bleeding injuries on the highway on Saturday. Locals initially suspected that he had been knocked down by an unidentified vehicle.

The case took a new turn after Subrahmanyam's father, Krishnaiah, raised suspicions about his daughter-in-law, Umadevi. He told police that he was unable to contact his son, daughter-in-law or grandson. When he reached their house, it was locked, while Umadevi and her son Lohith were reportedly missing.

Police subsequently examined the house and the route leading to the highway. Investigators reportedly found bloodstains and began analysing CCTV footage from the area.

The footage allegedly provided important clues about the movement of a two-wheeler and the suspected transportation of the body.

Pileru DSP Krishna Mohan said the preliminary investigation found that the couple had frequent disputes.

The DSP also said Subrahmanyam's father had alleged that Umadevi was involved in an extramarital relationship. Police are investigating the allegation and examining whether it could have provided a possible motive for the killing.

Investigators are also looking into whether anyone else assisted in moving and disposing of the body.

Umadevi and Lohith have been detained and questioned. Police are working to establish the exact sequence of events and determine whether Subrahmanyam was deliberately murdered.

Investigators are also examining whether his body was deliberately placed on the highway to make the death appear to be a road accident.
